lead_story: The Federal Reserve is facing an inflation credibility test after Congress hearings, with Fed Chairman Warsh's communication being closely watched. The odds of a July rate hike are rising, which could impact the US economy. Inflation slowed to 3.5% in June, but it remains to be seen if this trend will continue.
